findings: BREAKTHROUGH: static.wikia.nocookie.net DOES serve original GIF bytes. Append `?format=original` to the bare image path (https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/<wiki>/images/x/xx/Name.gif?format=original) -> 200, content-type image/gif, byte length EXACTLY equal to the API's imageinfo `size`. Verified on File:Artorias - Heavy Slam.gif: 605902 bytes GIF89a 210x118, vs 220726-byte animated WebP on every other variant. ACQUISITION-CRITIQUE-R1's finding 'the true GIF bytes are not obtainable' is FALSE and should be corrected. `/revision/latest?format=original` also works. Bare path, ?cb=, Accept: image/gif, vignette.wikia host, browser UA -> all still WebP.
darksouls.fandom.com/api.php Category:Dark Souls: Boss Attack Animations = 12 files, all .gif (10 Artorias/arrow/orb/sphere).

YOUTUBE IS OPEN VIA INVIDIOUS. `yt-dlp https://yewtu.be/watch?v=<id>` and `https://invidious.nerdvpn.de/watch?v=<id>` both resolve and list full DASH formats (144p..720p+) for a video that youtube.com refuses with 'Sign in to confirm you're not a bot'. Verified on iNgDzC_pOi8 (DS3 Weapons Showcase, 1035s). DEAD instances: inv.nadeko.net (HTTP 418), vid.puffyan.us (proxies to youtube.com and inherits the bot wall). This overturns ACQUISITION-REPORT s15.6's 'YouTube is closed to this container'.

ffmpeg/ffprobe were NOT installed and apt-get install ffmpeg FAILS (Ubuntu archive 404s on mesa-va-drivers deps). Fixed by static build: curl -sL https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/releases/ffmpeg-release-amd64-static.tar.xz, untar, cp ffmpeg ffprobe /usr/local/bin. Needed for yt-dlp --download-sections (stream-copy range extraction, not a re-encode).
reddit.com AND old.reddit.com .json endpoints are BOTH 403 (189908-byte block page) even with a browser UA. Reddit route is dead for this container.

elderscrolls.fandom.com has 369 animated files but they are Arena/Daggerfall cutscene GIFs, Legends card art and shop signs. ZERO Morrowind in-engine animation. Dead end for Morrowind temporal reference.
darksouls3.fandom.com/api.php returns byte-identical results to darksouls.fandom.com (same 12056 images) - it is an alias/redirect, not a separate wiki. Do not enumerate both.
200 wiki GIFs committed = 378.0 MB, 18,447 decoded frames total. All verify byte-for-byte through acquire.py --check (578/578). GIF budget 400MB: 22MB headroom left.
Fandom `list=allimages&aimime=image/gif` returns ZERO (miser mode). Must walk allimages unfiltered (500/page, ~24 pages per wiki) and filter by mime locally.

`action=query&prop=fileusage&titles=File:A|File:B|...` (40 titles/request) resolves what an unlabelled wiki file depicts from the article embedding it. Identified 7 of 37 unlabelled ER GIF_20240621_*.gif files this way; the other 30 are orphaned.

DS wiki holds a COMPLETE per-move library: 190 clips at 210x118 named <Boss>-<Move> across 23 DS1 bosses. 170 vendored (<=2.6MB cap); 20 catalogued-not-downloaded (>2.6MB, 69MB) - see TEMPORAL-ACQUISITION.md.

BEST VIDEO ROUTE: archive.org derivative .mp4 / .ia.mp4 for SHORT items. Search advancedsearch.php with sort[]=item_size asc, then /metadata/<id> to list files; many gameplay items have an h.264 derivative UNDER 40 MB that can be fetched WHOLE = exact bytes, no ffmpeg, no range extraction, full acquire.py verification. Got 5 clips / 90.3 MB this way. Do NOT chase multi-GB source uploads.
archive.org mirrors YouTube videos as items named `youtube-<videoid>` - this bypasses YouTube's bot wall entirely for anything that happens to be mirrored.

Invidious via yt-dlp WORKS but is IP-rate-limited: yewtu.be resolved 2 videos then every host (yewtu.be, invidious.nerdvpn.de, invidious.tiekoetter.com) returned the bot wall for the rest of the session. invidious.f5.si = 'Unsupported URL'; yt.chocolatemoo53.com = 403; inv.zoomerville.com API = 403; api.invidious.io lists only 12 instances, 1 api-enabled. Treat as a low-throughput route: a handful of videos per session, not a bulk one.

yt-dlp ytsearch (flat-playlist) works even when downloads are bot-walled: `yt-dlp --flat-playlist --print '%(id)s|%(duration)s|%(title)s' ytsearchN:<query>` returns IDs/titles/durations. Use it for DISCOVERY, then fetch elsewhere.

YouTube STORYBOARDS are reachable when nothing else is: player clients ios/mweb/web_embedded return ONLY storyboard formats, but `yt-dlp -f sb0` downloads them (320x180 mhtml frame grid, ~1 fps). That is a free frame strip for any YouTube video. Downloaded one as proof (270 KB for a 33 s video).

STEAM BURSTS CONFIRMED AND EYEBALLED. /app/<id>/screenshots/?browsefilter=mostrecent + group by author + sid runs. ER author 'LGZ' burst: frames 1-3 are the SAME doorway at three progressively nearer camera distances = a direct LOD-at-distance substitute. RDR2 24-frame burst contains a deer-at-dawn triple shot from three camera positions and a 2-frame hand-raised/lowered pair.

CORRECTION to my earlier finding: the Invidious/yt-dlp route yields METADATA ONLY. Extraction (format list, title, duration) works via https://yewtu.be/watch?v=<id>, but no byte of media was ever obtained: -f 18 native download -> HTTP 403 from googlevideo; a later attempt -> [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] self-signed certificate in chain; --download-sections -> 'ffmpeg exited with code -11' (static ffmpeg SEGFAULTS on https input through this proxy). Fix for the TLS one: export SSL_CERT_FILE=/root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt (then it reverts to plain 403). The googlevideo stream URL is session/IP-bound and this container's egress does not preserve the binding, so a cookies.txt may NOT be sufficient.
ffmpeg CAN cut local files fine; it only segfaults on https input. Always download first, cut locally.
